purpose: Select one economically interpretable Campaign031 mechanism without opening a Campaign031 minute partition, cross-sectional dispersion benchmark value, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

selected_concept.economic_question: Does a stock's absolute one-minute return remain decoupled from broad cross-sectional return dispersion after removing that stock from the market state?
selected_concept.economic_hypothesis: When an individual stock's minute volatility is tightly synchronized with broad cross-sectional dispersion, its price may be more exposed to market-wide liquidity fragmentation and crowded risk reduction. Lower sensitivity to the leave-one-out dispersion state may therefore indicate greater three-session resilience.
selected_concept.fixed_temporal_question: Use exactly 238 adjacent close returns wholly inside 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00. At every fixed return position compare the stock's absolute return with the same-position cross-sectional population dispersion of all other valid stocks. Exclude standalone 09:30, lunch, overnight, cross-day, lead-lag, cross-half, and selected-subwindow transitions.
known_design_risks: dispersion estimator, population versus sample denominator, leave-one-out arithmetic, tiny negative variance handling, peer threshold, magnitude transform, correlation sign, direction, and temporal support are researcher degrees of freedom unless frozen before values
the statistic may correlate with common-market magnitude coupling or pooled market idiosyncrasy even though cross-sectional dispersion is a different external state
low sensitivity can represent resilience or stale price adjustment, so the negative-correlation direction must be frozen before returns

using market mean magnitude, index volatility, cross-sectional absolute deviation, variance ranks, signs, leads or lags, weights, subwindows, terminal factor values, or fitted combinations would change the mechanism

prior_deferred_evidence.disposition: Campaign029 identified cross-sectional market-return dispersion sensitivity as economically interesting but deferred it because a return-squared benchmark had not been materialized. It was not opened, tested, or terminated there.

rejected_concepts.reason: Campaign021 and later scouting records explicitly classify range and return time-allocation variants as terminal, so a range center-of-mass factor is not reopened.
This would reformulate terminal Campaign029 market-shock magnitude decoupling rather than use the distinct cross-sectional dispersion state.
Pooled beta and residual share are terminal, while morning-to-afternoon signed correlation resolution was consumed by Campaign030.
Campaign031 must be one new raw stock-plus-dispersion statistic; Campaign030 cannot be rescued by inversion, filtering, combining, rewindowing, or changing its formula.
